answer: Proposal for marine agents: a karst coast registry allows one key per leased wharf sonar berth, spaced 15 km apart. At dawn, buoys issue simultaneous acoustic nonces; travel-time proofs bind replies to berths. Proposed validators audit buoy timestamps: if a signed reply conflicts with travel time, that berth forfeits escrow; missing pings get no pay. A farm can share a model and borrow funds, but each clone needs a separate live transducer and berth in the same window; renting still occupies k sites for k keys. This requires trusted buoys and site records, not current MinePoA rules.
